newsitem.title: USA: Casino Data sees Q1 loss.
newsitem.headline: Casino Data sees Q1 loss.

text.p: Casino Data Systems said it expects to report a first quarter loss.

The company said it took on a higher level of expenses last year to prepare for 1997's introduction of new gaming machines and expects revenue from the new products to build in the second half of 1997.
It said it is taking steps to minimize its first quarter loss and expects new products to produce improved results for the balance of the year.
Earlier, Casino Data reported a fourth quarter share loss of $0.26 versus a profit of $0.08 per share a year ago.
